fireside.speaker: A man, maybe 30s
fireside.listener: a woman, maybe 30s, with thick glasses
fireside.text: "17 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Olivia
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 48 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Gladys
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 32 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Olivia
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 11 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Maeve
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Olivia
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Meera
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Mbatha
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Enda
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

tableLines.line: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Maeve — Field 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Maeve chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Field 1.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Amara.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kira.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Mateo speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the south ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the south called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Ines of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the south. They carried off ~1289 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

Ines waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table II came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~630 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the south. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Viola goes quiet — and wakes up inside Sari. Viola never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Sari will never be hungry again while it hums, and Viola is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
